notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), curl: lib/cf-ip-happy.c through lib/openldap.c. These 123 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 55 FP, 68 TP.

TP shapes: parameters of non-static libcurl functions guarded only by DEBUGASSERT (connection-filter, connection-pool, ALPN, address-printing, DNS-cache and request-writing helpers); UNITTEST functions, which are extern in the UNITTESTS build (curl_setup.h:1506); curl_multi_wait/curl_multi_poll extra_fds; LDAP URL descriptors filled by the third-party ldap_url_parse, whose contract is not proof (medium). FP shapes: GOOD_EASY_HANDLE tests with a return; dominating loop and if tests; callees non-null on success; dynbuf buffers after a successful append (every writer in curlx/dynbuf.c); medium rows rest on dynhds and header-list invariants with all writers in the scanned source.

42 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
